sermon.title: The King’s Handover— November 28, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Israel was handed over for disobedience, and Satan accuses us as Haman accused the Jews. Esther came to the king and found favor; we come boldly to King Jesus, asking what pleases Him. Her story parallels Pentecost.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 21:09 after worship.

faqs.question: Why did God hand Israel over?
faqs.answer: They ignored the prophets and served idols.

faqs.question: Does Satan have power over us?
faqs.answer: He says no—God gave us power over all the enemy.

faqs.question: What did Satan ask about Peter?
What does God want to kill?
faqs.answer: The old man of sin, not you.

faqs.question: How should we approach God?
faqs.answer: Boldly to the throne of grace.

faqs.question: How does Esther parallel Acts 2?
faqs.answer: Every province and language heard; many converted and fear fell.

faqs.question: Whom does God accept?
faqs.answer: Those in every nation who fear Him and work righteousness.
